name: VRM_PERF_OBLIG_GRP_RULES_B
description: This table contains the rules for identification of performance obligations.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_GROUP_RULE_ID
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: segment of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority for a performance obligation group rule.

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Code name of  a performance obligation group classification. Values are derived from ORA_VRM_OBLIG_CLASSIF_CODE lookup type.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_METHOD
columns.description: Specifies whether the obligation is satisfied at a point in time or over time. Values are derived from  ORA_VRM_SATISFACTION_METHOD lookup type.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the rule is active.

columns.name: EXEMPTED_FROM_ALLOCATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the performance obligation created using this rule should be exempted from allocation.

columns.name: DEVOLVE_PO_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the performance obligation that was created using this performance obligation identification rule will be devolved. A performance obligation is devolved if the Devolve performance obligation option is set to Yes.

columns.name: IN_USE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is in-use and cannot be deleted.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: The process or user interface from which this row is created..

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
